image_description: A tall, wooden bookcase with a two-part design: an upper section with glass doors containing shelves of books, and a lower solid wood cabinet section with drawers or closed compartments. The bookcase is positioned indoors next to a potted plant with white flowers on the left and a dark radiator or vent structure on the right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bookcase exhibits clear horizontal lines dividing the upper glass section and the lower cabinet section, as well as internal shelf divisions.

artifact_observations.location: Books on shelves inside glass doors
artifact_observations.reasoning: The spines of the books lack distinct text or clear individual definition, appearing somewhat melted or smudged together. This is a common AI artifact where fine details like book titles fail to render correctly.
The perspective lines of the lower cabinet section seem slightly inconsistent with the upper section, creating a minor visual disconnect in the structural alignment.
The plant exhibits slight blurring and indistinct leaf edges, which could be depth-of-field effect but also resembles AI-generated softness in complex organic textures.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and distinguish it from similar furniture like cabinets or shelving units.
To verify the 3D structural integrity, ensuring the glass doors, shelves, and cabinet base align correctly in 3D space without melting or warping.
To check for boundary issues between the glass panels and the wooden frame, ensuring no fusion or bleeding artifacts exist at these critical interfaces.
To assess the severity of the texture anomalies in the books and the blur in the background plant, determining if they constitute significant generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Clarity and realism of book spines behind glass doors
Structural alignment between upper glass section and lower cabinet base
Boundary sharpness between glass panels and wooden frames
Texture consistency of wood grain across different sections
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines inside the glass case; AI often fails to render legible text or distinct boundaries here.
